title: Great Canon of the Azure Tide
summary: A canon of the grand tide that rolls over a whole front and the gentle eclipse that blinds and weighs down every foe.

title: Treatise of the Twin-Court Moon
summary: A treatise of two pulls and two phases worked as a court that holds a foe between them and turns each blow back.

title: Manual of the Hawk-Eyed Moon
summary: A manual of the moon seen from a high perch that stoops its pull on a lone foe and soars its tide over a field.

title: The Master's Moon of Mortal Strength
summary: A manual for a master of the mortal tier who brings the full strength of the waxing moon to a body not yet Xiantian.

title: The Wind-Sworn Great Tide
summary: A manual of the great tide sworn to the wind that pulls with no wall to hide behind and a vow to hold it.

title: Book of the Oath Under the Moon
summary: A book of the oath spoken to the moon that weighs on a promise-breaker and lights a path for the oath-keeper.

title: Canon of the Held Bearing of Tides
summary: A canon of keeping one bearing steady against every tide and of turning the tide round that held bearing.

title: The Sworn Tide of the Master Moon
summary: A manual for a master of the mortal tier who swears the moon's tide to a single bearing and holds it there.
